title: Add modem docs and examples
description:
Document the modem framework and add user-facing examples for presets, custom constellations, and simulation integration.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Documentation explains the common preset workflow and the custom-constellation workflow.
- [ ] Examples cover at least one custom constellation, one Gray-QAM preset, and one simulation-harness integration path.
- [ ] Public-facing docs make the intended ergonomics of the modem framework clear.

## Notes

This is the first leaf under the ergonomics and validation story.
